tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart's appVersion when empty.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.

namespaceOverride.description: Override the namespace for namespaced resources.

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Defaults to the chart fullname.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

config.description: Controller configuration written into the ConfigMap.

unhealthyDelayMinutes.description: Minutes a node must remain NotReady before the out-of-service taint is applied.

recoveryDelayMinutes.description: Minutes a node must remain Ready after being tainted before the taint is removed.

maxUnhealthyPercentage.description: Circuit-breaker threshold: stop applying taints when this percentage of watched nodes is NotReady. Set to "100" to disable.

nodeLabelSelector.description: Optional label selector to restrict which nodes are watched. Leave empty to watch all nodes.

metricsBindAddress.description: Address the metrics endpoint binds to.

healthProbeBindAddress.description: Address the health probe endpoint binds to.

leaderElect.description: Enable leader election for high availability.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the controller Pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Security context applied at the Pod level.

securityContext.description: Security context applied at the container level.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the controller Pod.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling the controller Pod.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the controller Pod.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration for the controller container.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for the controller container.

serviceMonitor.description: Prometheus ServiceMonitor configuration. Requires the Prometheus Operator.

enabled.description: Create a ServiceMonitor resource for Prometheus scraping.

interval.description: Interval at which Prometheus should scrape the metrics endpoint.

scrapeTimeout.description: Scrape timeout. Must be less than or equal to interval.

additionalLabels.description: Additional labels to add to the ServiceMonitor.
